name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.2-beta+5

- iPhone: AirPlay with AnymeX+'s own remote; LG and other TVs play MKVs over DLNA
  - AirPlay no longer opens Apple's player: the TV plays the video and the Cast to Device sheet shows a remote (play/pause, seek, back/forward 10 s, change TV, stop). Stopping brings the player back to the same spot. Keeps playing with the phone locked.
  - iPhone now finds AirPlay TVs (like LG) and asks them directly for DLNA, so they show up in the cast list and play MKV files themselves.
  - "Can't see your TV? Add it by IP address" in Cast to Device (remembered).
  - DLNA TVs are told the real file type (MKV, WebM…) instead of always MP4.
